description:
The Brant Foundation and Brooklyn-based bicycle brand Affinity Cycles have partnered to offer the Affinity x Keith Haring balance bike, with a portion of proceeds from each purchase donated to Free Arts NYC.
This is the bike your kid will give to their kid, skip the training wheels your child will love this balance bike from the start. Recommended for children 2+.
White wash birch panel with vibrant water based screen printed graphics. adjustable saddle height when the little one grows.
Comes with an oversized (lined) rip stop tote bag for mom and dad, screen printed with all over graphics, also a matching bike stand.
Co designed with David Mawhinney/Franklin and Emily.
Free Arts NYC is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to providing free, high-quality arts programming for youth in underserved communities. Each purchase directly supports their mentorship and creative programs, helping young people build confidence, develop creativity, and gain the skills they need to succeed.
MSRP: $299.99
Shipping additional where applicable.
